changelog:
- Major revision: Overhauled skill for persistent, auto-triggered ultra-terse technical communication with adjustable intensity.
- Added support for intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra.
- Improved persistence: Caveman mode remains active on all responses until explicit "stop caveman" or "normal mode" command.
- Expanded and clarified rules for terseness, synonym usage, code handling, error quoting, and example formats.
- Introduced auto-clarity rules to temporarily suspend caveman mode for warnings or ambiguity.
- Updated documentation with detailed examples for each intensity level and clear boundaries for appropriate usage.
